bio: Enjoy a delicious traditional Afternoon Tea in the peaceful gardens or the quaint library of The Crown Manor House Hotel. Situated in the beautiful New Forest, The Crown Manor Hotel is the ideal location to treat yourself to a classic Afternoon Tea.  Diners can chose to have their Afternoon Tea served in the gardens, the library or the Bar & Grill.  Regardless of their choice, diners will find a peaceful environment to talk with friends over a range of quintessential Afternoon Tea treats.  With a celebration afternoon tea, enjoy two glasses of prosecco , indulge in a selection of dainty finger sandwiches with traditional fillings before moving onto warm scones with jam and clotted cream and a range of desserts.  Situated in Lyndhurst, The Crown Manor Hotel is a historical building and ideally located for those exploring the New Forest.
